name: tpg-scheduler-codex-plugin
description: Codex in-app browser assistant for confirmation-gated TPG Dynamics 365 project status reports.

interface.shortDescription: Drafts Dynamics 365 status reports for projects you lead.
interface.longDescription: A confirmation-gated Codex in-app Browser assistant for Dynamics 365 TPG projects. It uses the Browser plugin, not a separate browser process, to open active candidate projects from the Dynamics view, keep only records where Project Manager is Reiner Weisssieker, ask for a per-project status input, map kv to the fixed unchanged-status sentence, stage a Quick Create Status Update, and wait for explicit confirmation before saving.
defaultPrompt: Create status reports for my TPG projects.
Start the TPG status reporting workflow in the Codex Browser.
Prepare CRM status drafts for my projects.
